tests.detail: Source PNG, spec and unchanged SVG match native render hashes; native status must pass.
All N18 nonfigure prose/captions in ZH and EN plus all ten actual retained ZH N19 paragraphs; English N19 remains unbound.
Exactly six separate LC drawings in two rows of three, including repeated zero-charge state, and exactly two spring masses.
First quarter-period, column 1: initial maximum charge, upper positive / lower negative; zero current, no arrow or current label in source; no arrow/current label.
First quarter-period, column 2: partially discharging, upper positive / lower negative; nonzero current increasing during first quarter-period; i arrow downward.
First quarter-period, column 3: zero charge; both plates blank, no +/- or q label; maximum current; I_m arrow downward.
Second quarter-period, column 1: zero charge; source repeats the blank-plate maximum-current state; maximum current at start of second quarter-period; I_m arrow downward.
Second quarter-period, column 2: partially recharging with reversed polarity, upper negative / lower positive; nonzero current decreasing during second quarter-period; i arrow downward.

Second quarter-period, column 3: opposite maximum charge, upper negative / lower positive; half-period, not a full-cycle return; zero current, no arrow or current label in source; no arrow/current label.
All four arrows represent the source downward current, including both zero-charge pictures; no invented spring velocity arrow.
Top spring is at equilibrium with source maximum velocity v_m; solid horizontal extension is not an arrow.
Lower source picture is above the equilibrium reference, with x_m, solid position extension and vertical displacement marker.
Every wire, marker, support/spring segment and current arrow has an executable connects assertion.
